argv: echo @@recovery-dmesg; dmesg; echo @@pstore; if test -d /sys/fs/pstore; then ls -l /sys/fs/pstore; for f in /sys/fs/pstore/*; do if test -f "$f"; then echo "@@file $f"; cat "$f"; fi; done; else echo absent; fi; echo @@last-kmsg; if test -f /proc/last_kmsg; then cat /proc/last_kmsg; else echo absent; fi
